answer:
Call **`/api/embed`** (POST to `http://localhost:11434/api/embed`). Its `input` field takes either a single string or an array of strings. The docs show the single-string form: "input": "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]. For batches, "Pass an array of strings to `input`." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

The request also needs a `model` field, such as `"model": "embeddinggemma"` [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md].

The API reference also lists an older-looking endpoint, `/api/embeddings`, which takes a `prompt` field instead of `input`: "prompt": "Here is an article about llamas..." [ollama/docs/api.md]. The context doesn't say whether it's deprecated, so I'd use `/api/embed` unless you have a reason to need the other one.
